text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While heading to the Trainer's Room for a 
meeting with Mejiro Ardan—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! S-Sorry! Could ya hide me 
for just a bit?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tamamo-san. Good day. Is something the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: She's... she's chasing right after me...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: “—Taaa~maaa~chaaa~n. Where are you~?”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
S-She's here! Explanations later, get into 
the Trainer's room now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Phew, you really saved my bacon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Are you playing hide-and-seek with 
Creek-san, Tamamo-san? Hehe, you two get 
along so well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that casual of a thing! At 
this rate, I'm gonna end up as her little 
dress-up doll!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... It might be best to hear what 
you have to say after you've calmed down a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, it all started when Creek won 
some kind of fancy new high-end baby 
rattle from the lottery raffle.”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She just can't resist using new gear... 
Creek's clearly determined to turn me into 
a baby all over again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... so you were worried about being 
turned into a doll, were you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, from what you've told me... 
doesn't it simply mean that Creek-san just 
wants to play with you, Tamamo-san?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
H-How can you be so relaxed about 
this...?! You can only say that because 
you've never been babied before, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I shall come along 
too. See? It won't be scary then, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
T-That's reassuring and all, but... right 
now, I don't have the confidence to look 
Creek in the eye and talk to her 
properly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"You've just run so much that you're tired 
and feel a bit vulnerable. Let's rest a 
little, and then go talk with Creek-san 
together."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Come now, lay down—I'll give you a lap 
pillow. You have nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of when the Mejiro children 
would tire themselves out playing and take 
naps in my room when they were little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it feels like I've gained a little 
sister. Don't worry... have a nice, long 
rest—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I-I'm... the younger sister...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hold on a sec! That ain't barely 
any different from what Creek does to me 
anyway!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, was that so?
choice_data_list:
You do have that big-sisterly vibe, after 
all.

It's better than being treated like a 
baby...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I ain't kiddin'! I can't be havin' you 
treat me like your little sister outta 
nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This place is a danger zone for me too! 
I'm heading home!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, please wa—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Tama-chan♪ We finally meet♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: G Y A A A A A A H――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... after that, a game of chase 
unfolded with those fleeing, those 
pursuing, and Mejiro Ardan running in an 
attempt to mediate.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
G-Ghhnnngh...! What kind of impossible 
choice is this...?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Guess I got no choice... I'll listen to 
Ardan for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm honored that you rely on me. Now 
then, please get some restful sleep...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Shall I sing you a lullaby? ――♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Gnnnhhh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as Tamamo Cross sat there with an 
intensely conflicted look receiving a lap 
pillow, a gentle lullaby filled the 
Trainer's Room—
